integrity: A complete proof and exact-standard-library checker are included. Finite enumeration tests finite cases and does not replace the all-orders proof.
scientific_limitations: Simple 2-regular two-partner networks only; uniform fixed-count or iid habitat loss, instantaneous secondary extinctions, no cascades, no weighted or heterogeneous dependencies. Strict uniqueness of full-polynomial/Bernoulli extremizers does not assert strict inequalities at every individual deletion count. Broader earlier graph-polynomial results may remain unindexed; historical priority subject to independent check.
title: Sharp coextinction-risk extremizers in two-partner regular ecological networks
